info.description:
OpenAPI definition for the Thumr plant marketplace backend. The specification is structured
so it can be imported directly into Amazon API Gateway. Each operation is secured with a Cognito
user pool authorizer unless otherwise noted and integrates with a dedicated Lambda function via
the `x-amazon-apigateway-integration` vendor extension.
